corrected_text: Agello's engine load log reports the E4B file's capabilities as 'mtp=true thinking=false tools=false vision=true audio=true maxContext=0 maxVisionBudget=280' with our builds of 2026-10-15: fc71d704a349 on an iPhone 17 Pro (each of the four loads of calibrate-host-idle.json) and c5460a024e71 on an Apple M6 Mac. Both runs predate Agello 93122b6, when the app's catalog pointed to the first fp16-rope revision 13d5aa4c (2048-token blocks); the capabilities come from LlmMetadata and section types that are the same in a1693e22 and Google's 2eee7ac3 file. maxContext=0 is the context those builds couldn't read from E4B's main section; since cc97925b (2026-11-14, in our build and the release Agello ships) ModelInfo reports 32,003.

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: the claim cited a load log of Google's v0.18.0 runtime (memory-google-host-idle.json); the same caps line is in our build's iPhone run of the same evening, calibrate-host-idle.json (runtimeBuild fc71d704a349, startedAt 2026-10-15T18:08:30Z, before Agello 93122b6 at 19:00:17Z), in all four scenarios, and in inference-final.json 01_load on the M6 (c5460a024e71).
